flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob (eNotification SMS batch for ENA/RD1 etc. notices, not warrants) and ocmsadminapi utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil as the generic SMS mechanism. No code for DOS, a warrant SMS batch or warrant SMS content in the six repos
note: The story asks for an SMS reminder batch job for warrant defendants: mobile numbers from DOS, unique defendants per batch, SMS body with warrant notice details. There is no code for it: grep for warrant/dnata/wa in all Java src returns nothing, and there is no job, template or query that selects notices in a warrant state. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo (only a DOS Reports UI screen without a controller exists). What exists is the generic SMS mechanism for eNotification (ENA/RD1 etc.): NotificationSmsEmailJob sends a batch SMS through notificationHelper.sendBatchSms, with phone number dedup (normalizedPhone) and cron.notification.enabled=false in prod. That is not a warrant SMS, so it is not claimed as meeting the story. The story status is blank in the data; the requirement is not given. No relevant maintenance ticket (OCMS-DF-2026-180 is about the ENA date, not warrants).
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the generic batch SMS mechanism can be reused; the DOS number source, warrant defendant selection and warrant SMS content do not exist

steps.step: OCMS gets defendants' mobile numbers from DOS
steps.detail: There is no DOS integration in the backend; the only trace is the DOS Reports staff UI screen (ReportListDOS.tsx:82) without a controller or authorization mapping. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. No code fetches mobile numbers for warrant defendants.

steps.step: Pick each unique defendant once per batch
steps.detail: The dedup in NotificationSmsEmailJob uses normalizedPhone for ENA/RD1 notification records, not a warrant defendant selection. No query or job selects notices in a warrant state (grep warrant returns nothing in ocmsadminprivateapi).

steps.step: Write an SMS with warrant notice details
steps.detail: The SMS body is built from eNotification templates per stage; there is no warrant template or field (warrant no, type, court date) in any backend.

steps.step: Send the reminder SMS to defendants
steps.detail: A batch SMS sending mechanism exists (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:286-292 calls sendBatchSms when smsEnabled), but for eNotification reminders, not warrants. Execution is switched off by config: cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; notification.sms.enabled=true (application.properties:176). The real server value cannot be verified from the repo. Sebagian because it is a generic mechanism, not the feature the story names.
